test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the basic size of the diameter of a shaft is 80 mm and the variation limit of pm0.07 mm is given, then its high limit and low limit are_____ and_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Option 4**(80.07, 79.93)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Basic size of shaft__: 80 mm.
 
• __Variation limit__: ±0.07 mm.
 
• __High limit__: 80 + 0.07 = 80.07 mm.
 
• __Low limit__: 80 - 0.07 = 79.93 mm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Limits and Fits:**

 
 
• Limits define the permissible variation in dimensions of a component.
 
• The high limit is the maximum allowable dimension.
 
• The low limit is the minimum allowable dimension.
 
 
 
• **Tolerances:**
 
 
• Tolerance is the total permissible variation in the dimension.
 
• It ensures parts fit and function as intended.
